questions.question: First apply sort_bars(order=ascending). If someone wants the lightest drinks on average, which categories sit at the start of that ordering?

answer.value: Coffee, then Shaken Iced Beverages, then Classic Espresso Drinks

key_insights: Plain coffee categories cluster at the low-calorie end once bars are sorted ascending.
Blended and signature lines only appear after those lighter buckets.

reasoning.reasoning: Ascending sort lines categories up from the smallest mean calories upward.
